authorization: User requested stage-three real code tasks and randomized crossover testing.
design: Four task IDs times two rounds, with each paired block executing both arms in a seeded random order. Four base-first and four full-first blocks. Shuffle blocks before requests and save the full schedule and seed in the receipt.
previousAttempt: v1 retained separately: six deliveries then CSV timeout, with shell attempts despite the prompt. Never pool v1 and v2 scores. v2 adds a file-tool execution guard, explicit stop-after-write wording and per-turn provider budget.
workspace: Same temporary workspace path for both arms. Reset identical starter, public tests and specification before every fresh session. Only solution.cjs may change.
hostReadBoundary: Observed protocol limitation: the file-tool guard restricts tool names, not read paths. Hidden tests are not placed in the model workspace, but Host read access is not guaranteed confined there. Receipt lacks per-call path arguments; do not claim strict read isolation or leak prevention. Evaluator subprocess permissions are a separate restriction.
quality: Execute the actual delivered source in fresh Node processes against fixed public and hidden tests. Hidden tests and reference solutions are never written into the model workspace. Whole-task success requires all checks, changed source, intact fixtures and a completed turn. Do not repair failed model code or feed hidden failures back.
validation: Before provider calls: verify references pass all tests and starters fail; retain suite hashes. Execution timeout 5 seconds per public/hidden subprocess, memory ceiling 128 MB, no inherited credentials. Node permission allows only evaluation-directory reads, no writes/child processes/addons/workers/WASI. Module hooks allow only assertions and local test/solution modules; fetch and direct builtin/binding entry points are disabled. These are process-level restrictions, not an OS security sandbox against malicious escape.
metrics: official-price CNY per passed task including failed-task cost
complete provider usage and cache share
cache: Observe provider cache usage, never infer from hashes. No cold-cache or cache-purge claim. Randomized order balances which arm runs first but does not remove persistent cache carryover.
stop: A turn timeout or six-call limit cancels that turn, waits for its settled end and scores it failed; continue only if full provider audit and fixture integrity remain available. Stop the run on unresolved cancellation, unexpected approval, incomplete audit, transport failure, global budget or fixture changes outside solution.cjs. Ordinary hidden-test failures remain scored failures and do not stop the other trials.
retention: Save every receipt, provider audit and delivered source separately. Keep failures, no score pooling with the earlier JSON pilot.
scope: Bounded generated software maintenance tasks, not real-world repository or mathematical modeling benchmark. Extra capabilities are available in the full arm, but both arms receive the same file-only task instructions; no claim about benefit from using web, delegation or Fusion.
pricing: Rechecked official CNY pricing during this run (2026-10-16 Beijing). Actual response model and observed Beijing peak window determine estimates; unverified holiday eligibility yields a range. Not an account bill.
